title: TRACE: a build-quality audit for multi-omic cancer subtyping, and the limits of composite trust scores for transportability
description: Code reproducing all analyses of the TRACE study: an auditable simulation plus real-data validation on open-access TCGA, METABRIC, and TCGA glioma DNA methylation cohorts. A methods study, not a clinical validation.
